title: Vehicle Terrain Sensor
text: 车辆和轮胎到对象的距离，输入 2 路、输出 3 路；{Tag for actor in 3D scene, ActorTag} 指定名称 SimulinVehicle1、{Distance to vehicle center} 指定 Constant、{Distance to tire center} 指定 Constant、{Distance from vehicle center to front, VehCntrLngthVal} 指定车辆中心、{Distance from tire center to ground, TireRadiiVal} 指定轮胎半径、{Vehicle body x-axis trace length, VehRayLngth} 指定追踪长度、{Left front wheel z-axis trace length, LfRayLngth} 指定追踪长度、{Right front wheel z-axis trace length, RfRayLngth} 指定追踪长度、{Left rear wheel z-axis trace length, LrRayLngth} 指定追踪长度、{Right rear wheel z-axis trace length, RrRayLngth} 指定追踪长度、{Vehicle body x-axis trace offset, VehRayOffset} 指定车辆射线追踪偏移、{Left front wheel z-axis trace offset, LfRayOffset} 指定左前轮射线追踪偏移、{Right front wheel z-axis trace offset, RfRayOffset} 指定右前轮射线追踪偏移、{Left rear wheel z-axis trace offset, LrRayOffset} 指定左后轮射线追踪偏移、{Right rear wheel z-axis trace offset, RrRayOffset} 指定右后轮射线追踪偏移、{Vehicle body} 启用车辆车身射线追踪、{Left front tire} 启用左前轮胎射线追踪、{Right front tire} 启用右前轮胎射线追踪、{Left rear tire} 启用左后轮胎射线追踪、{Right rear tire} 启用右后轮胎射线追踪、{Trace line visualization} 指定可视化射线追踪、{Sample time} 指定采样时间，按实例取值。
